name: k6
description: Grafana k6 CLI resource with a thin Go entrypoint and external-cli-specific logic organized under internal packages.

limitations: The upstream executable, licensing, authentication, and version policy are host-managed.

linux: if command -v snap >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo snap install k6; elif command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo gpg -k >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; sudo gpg --no-default-keyring --keyring /usr/share/keyrings/k6-archive-keyring.gpg --keyserver hkp://keyserver.ubuntu.com:80 --recv-keys C5AD17C747E3415A3642D57D77C6C491D6AC1D69 2>/dev/null || wget -q -O - https://dl.k6.io/key.gpg | sudo gpg --dearmor -o /usr/share/keyrings/k6-archive-keyring.gpg; echo 'deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/k6-archive-keyring.gpg] https://dl.k6.io/deb stable main' | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/k6.list >/dev/null; sudo apt-get update; sudo apt-get install -y k6; else tmp_dir=$(mktemp -d); arch=$(uname -m); case "$arch" in x86_64) arch=amd64 ;; aarch64|arm64) arch=arm64 ;; *) echo "Unsupported architecture: $arch" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac; url="https://github.com/grafana/k6/releases/download/v0.49.0/k6-v0.49.0-linux-$arch.tar.gz"; curl -fsSL "$url" -o "$tmp_dir/k6.tar.gz"; tar -xzf "$tmp_dir/k6.tar.gz" -C "$tmp_dir"; sudo mv "$tmp_dir/k6-v0.49.0-linux-$arch/k6" /usr/local/bin/k6; sudo chmod +x /usr/local/bin/k6; rm -rf "$tmp_dir"; fi
